name: CMU Chiang Mai Marathon 2026
short_description: CMU Chiang Mai Marathon 2026, the 10th edition, is on Sunday 8 November 2026 at Chiang Mai University, with a marathon, half marathon, 10.5 km and 5.5 km.
ai_summary: The CMU Chiang Mai Marathon 2026 is the 10th edition of Chiang Mai University's charity race, held with its alumni association on Sunday 8 November 2026. It offers a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10.5 km mini marathon and a 5.5 km fun run, with race packs collected at Sala Ang Kaew on the campus the day before. The organiser has capped the onsite field at 7,000 runners.

core_facts.organizer: Chiang Mai University with the Chiang Mai University Alumni Association

faqs.question: When is CMU Chiang Mai Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: It is on Sunday 8 November 2026, the race's 10th edition; the previous one was held on 1 February 2026. Race packs are collected on Saturday 7 November from 9am to 8pm at Sala Ang Kaew, Chiang Mai University. Runners who start more than 15 minutes after their wave is released are disqualified.

faqs.question: What distances and entry fees does the CMU Chiang Mai Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: Four distances: a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10.5 km mini marathon and a 5.5 km fun run. In its announcement the organiser put onsite entry at THB 1,100 for the marathon and THB 950 for the half, with a VIP entry at THB 2,000, and capped the onsite field at 7,000 runners.

faqs.question: Who can enter each category?
faqs.answer: Marathon and half-marathon age groups start at 20-29 for Thai runners, while foreign marathon runners race in a single category without age groups. The mini marathon's age groups start at 16-19, and runners under 18 need a guardian's permission. A virtual-run version is offered alongside the race through the same 42one95 entry platform.
